name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 9 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 26 hours starting 2025-07-04, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
